title: W7-B/P-PROD-9: Abuse limits verified as deployed behaviour, including cancel's exemption

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Exhaustion per operation — approve (5/hour burst 2), confirmations (30/hour), SSE (10 concurrent): 429 with Retry-After and agent_abuse_limit_exceeded security event from captured log records
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Tests verify 429 responses with Retry-After headers and caplog assertions on security event records with shop_id and operation fields

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Cancel unthrottled mid-storm: exhaust every other limit for a shop, then cancel a run and assert success through HTTP route
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Tests exhaust all three limits (approve, confirmation, SSE) for a shop, then verify POST /v1/demo/runs/{run_id}/cancel returns 202. Structural proof: cancel route never calls get_agent_abuse_limit_gate()

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Redis outage: approve/confirmation/SSE fail CLOSED and cancel succeeds DURING the simulated outage
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Tests bind UnavailableAbuseLimitGate (simulating Redis outage), verify 429 on rate-limited operations, and 202 on cancel

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Buckets keyed per shop after auth, not per IP: two shops behind one caller do not share a bucket; one shop across two callers does
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Tests use get_active_shop dependency override to test multiple shops sharing same HTTP client, verifying buckets are keyed by shop_id

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Limits read from documented env vars; unset uses documented default; malformed value fails loudly, never silently defaults
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Tests verify defaults match ADR-075 decision 4, env vars are read correctly, and ValueError is raised on malformed/non-positive values

acceptance_criteria.criterion: SSE concurrency asserted by holding N streams open and opening N+1 — not by unit-testing the counter alone
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Tests acquire N slots directly, then verify HTTP GET /v1/demo/runs/{run_id}/events on (N+1)th returns 429

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Nginx limit_req lint: assert limit_req on /webhooks/tiktok and /v1/demo/*, authenticated catch-all has generous zone. Must fail when zone removed, revert cannot leave zone referenced-but-undefined
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Tests parse Nginx config, verify zones defined and referenced correctly, detect undefined references, and demonstrate zone removal detection

candidate_verification_journey.description: On the candidate port, exhaust the approve limit for a test shop and observe 429 + Retry-After; then cancel a run for the same shop and observe success. Confirm the Nginx candidate config carries the limit_req zones.
steps: Deploy this slice to the candidate environment
Exhaust AGENT_APPROVE_RATE_LIMIT_BURST_MAX_REQUESTS (default 2) for a test shop by POSTing to /v1/demo/decisions/{action_card_id}/approve twice
Verify third approve returns 429 with Retry-After header
Verify /etc/nginx/conf.d/rate-limits.conf defines webhook_tiktok, demo_public, auth_callback, api_authenticated zones
Verify /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/api.app-juli.com.conf references these zones on appropriate locations

rollback_plan: If a limit is tightened by this slice, reverting loosens it. Assert the revert cannot leave a zone referenced but undefined—this would fail Nginx config validation and take the site down on reload.

scope_notes.out_of_scope: Changing limit VALUES is out of scope unless a value is provably wrong. This slice verifies the mechanism.

implementation_changes.change: Updated _int_env() to fail loudly on malformed/non-positive values instead of silently defaulting. This is a mechanism change to detect config errors immediately.
implementation_changes.reason: Acceptance criterion requires malformed env vars to fail loudly, not silently default.
